name: Spool Up: 2026 Race Starts
author: nyannoying
description: The 2026 start the game leaves out, on F1 2026 cars: a 5 s Pre-Start, a turbo you spool yourself, AI that can fumble and the low-output safety net. Offline Grand Prix and Career, races and sprints. Other cars keep the game's normal start.

options.label: Pre-Start phase
options.description: Adds the FIA's 5 s flashing blue phase before the first red light (Article B5.7.2 b). F1 2026 cars only.

options.label: 2026 launch physics
options.description: Engine power depends on the turbo spool you built before lights out, and AI cars get random starts: mostly clean, some poor, a few fumbled. The MGU-K limit below 50 km/h is in the game's own 2026 car data, so it applies either way.

options.label: Low-output start safety net
options.description: A car low on power that accelerates abnormally slowly gets just enough MGU-K from its own battery to keep a minimum acceleration until 50 km/h, and a flashing on-screen warning. AI cars too.

options.label: Apply launch physics to AI
options.description: Off gives every AI car its normal launch, with no bad starts, which makes your start much harder.

options.label: Turbo spool time (s)
options.description: Mod tuning value, not an FIA number: seconds at high revs to reach full boost.

options.label: Spool revs (rpm)
options.description: Mod tuning value: engine speed above which the turbo gains boost.
